english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a preference or liking for one option over others.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a personal preference or liking.

examples.english: My preference for tea is for lighter flavours.
examples.traditional: 我對茶嘅偏好比較清淡。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 caa4 ge3 pin1 hou3 bei2 gaau3 cing1 daam6

examples.english: I have a predilection for light flavours.
